openingHook: Some businesses never need to persuade customers that the problem exists.
The pain, the embarrassment, or the deadline has already done that work.
review: Script compared with source chapter openings, endings, key technical passages and worked examples; complete source extraction retained for traceability.
qualifierChecks: Research claims presented as proposals rather than verified superiority.
No title metaphor promoted into medical guidance.
No unsupported field-first claims or claimed guaranteed reader outcomes.
sourceReviewScope: Complete canonical HTML text extracted and indexed; all chapter boundaries mapped; editorial reading reviewed chapter openings/endings, the central argument, conclusions, qualifications and selected technical or commercial examples.
